title: Structural Analysis (Stress)
description: Structural Analysis (Stress) as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are load cases for the installation identified?
Are structural attachment points and load paths proposed?
Vibration and Shock: is the vibration and shock environment of the installation zone identified?
Vibration and Shock: is clamp and support spacing assessed against the installed vibration spectrum?
Are preliminary strength and stiffness margins positive?
Are fatigue and damage tolerance needs assessed?
Vibration and Shock: are shock loads on heavy equipment mounts assessed?
Are final stress margins positive for all load cases, with the analysis recorded?
Are fastener and joint allowables confirmed?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
